phase: Known-data resource/compatibility screen, not a latency or independent efficacy gate
case_selection: ALL 15 old states from ALL five documents; sorted filenames, no selection by prior outcome
termination: Append one fixed GPT2 EOS ID 50256; EOT=PAD=50256. Earlier termination is allowed only if every remaining original fixed position permits padding. This is a new terminated target over OLD weights, not a fresh model output.
candidate: True terminated shallow mass plus A24 closed surrogate lexical-counter tail; no new first-overflow refinement
initial_canvas: Compile once per initial old frame/depth. Original IDs/bytes and fixed canvas preserved. Construct the symbolic global-class graph before classical Hopcroft minimization, then restore original IDs; no unnecessary original-V expansion before minimization. All native kernels get this optimization.
native_weight_boundary: Native logits are logs of the identical old binary64 probabilities, then cast to the configured dtype; fixed rows explicitly singleton. This floating law is not asserted bit-exactly equal to the integer reference.
checks: Native sample lies in the true JSON EOT PAD* language and preserves all fixed IDs. Compare all sampled free-slot confidences with exact integer DAG marginals; finite absolute error <=0.005 for fp32 and <=1e-8 for fp64. Log all warnings/NaN fallbacks, zero masses/refusals/errors.
plausibility_rule: Only consider a full consumer protocol if >=3/15 initial states have a nonzero terminated shallow mass, certificate <=0.001 and at least one unchanged native GPU kernel/configuration completes correctly at that depth. This resource rule does not confirm speed, originality, useful semantic effect or publication. Never count a conservative allocation guard as a measured out-of-memory failure.
cost_recording: Record all preparation/summary/certificate/minimization/native materialization/copy/sample/confidence/validation diagnostic wall+CPU and peak CUDA allocation. A single known-data replay is explicitly not a positive timing comparison; no new model forward is run and old forward timing is not added as though newly executed.
fresh_branch: Requires a separate frozen consumer/controls/cost/selection protocol, independent external inputs, and a credible substantial benefit argument before any fresh model campaign. This screen alone cannot satisfy the user goal.
